channel.title: Jacob + Madison Faculty Job Matches
channel.description: Broad assistant-professor and assistant-eligible open-rank matches for the Fall 2027 cycle from six approved university sources. Unstated start dates are flagged for verification.

item.title: Stanford — Pharmacoepidemiology
item.description: Open-rank search in real-world evidence, causal inference, and comparative effectiveness. Strongest fit: Jacob. Fall 2027 timing requires verification.

item.title: Stanford — Surgery Policy Improvement Research & Education
item.description: Open-rank search in AI-enabled surgical policy, outcomes, and decision-making. Fit: Jacob and Madison. Fall 2027 timing requires verification.

item.title: Stanford — Health Policy (Health Economist)
item.description: Open-rank search in health systems, delivery, payment, digital health, and AI. Strongest fit: Jacob. Fall 2027 timing requires verification.

item.title: Stanford GSE — Education in a Rapidly Changing World
item.description: Open-rank search in education, inequality, and technological change. Strongest fit: Madison. Fall 2027 timing requires verification.

item.title: Stanford — Communication: Media and Politics
item.description: Assistant Professor search in media, politics, data science, and computational or experimental methods. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Berkeley — Demography, Open Field
item.description: Assistant Professor search including computational demography, health and aging, migration, and population dynamics. Fit: Jacob and Madison.

item.title: Berkeley Haas — Quantitative Marketing
item.description: Assistant Professor search in analytics, digital markets, and quantitative methods. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Berkeley Haas — Organizations, Entrepreneurship and Innovation
item.description: Assistant Professor search in organizations, innovation, performance, and inequality.

item.title: Berkeley — Sociology, Open Field
item.description: Assistant Professor search with no restriction on specialization. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Stanford — Political Science, Open Field
item.description: Open-field, open-rank Political Science search. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Berkeley — American Politics or Public Law
item.description: Assistant Professor search in American politics or public law. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Berkeley Haas — Finance
item.description: Assistant Professor search spanning banking, credit, regulation, mortgages, and insurance. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: UCLA Law — Open Field
item.description: Entry-level tenure-track law search beginning July 1, 2027. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: USC Price/Schaeffer — Research Assistant Professor of Health Policy & Management
item.description: Research-line Assistant Professor role in health policy, health economics, healthcare delivery, and policy-relevant research. Strongest fit: Jacob. Fall 2027 timing requires verification.

item.title: USC Keck — Health Behavior Data Analytics
item.description: Assistant Professor search in computational public health, digital platforms, experiments, networks, NLP, and machine learning. Official source is currently unavailable; verify before applying.

item.title: Northwestern IEMS — Two Faculty Positions
item.description: One Assistant Professor and one open-rank tenure-line search in optimization, AI and machine learning, financial engineering, and healthcare operations. Strong fit for Jacob and Madison; expected Fall 2027 start should be verified.

item.title: Northwestern Kellogg — AI and Innovation
item.description: Assistant or untenured Associate Professor search in AI, innovation, organizational decisions, and networks for academic year 2027–28. Strongest fit: Madison.

item.title: Stanford — Comparative Politics
item.description: Open-rank Comparative Politics search beginning September 1, 2027. Strongest fit: Madison.
